description: This file defines a class 'Percentiles' which contains static methods for statistical calculations including percentile, percentile rank, quartile, and rank. It is part of the PhpSpreadsheet library's calculation module, specifically under statistical functions.

classes.name: Percentiles
classes.description: A class providing static methods for statistical calculations such as percentile, rank, quartile, and percentile rank.

methods.name: PERCENTILE
methods.description: Calculates the nth percentile of a range of values.

methods.name: PERCENTRANK
methods.description: Calculates the rank of a value within a data set as a percentage.

methods.name: QUARTILE
methods.description: Calculates the quartile of a data set.

methods.name: RANK
methods.description: Calculates the rank of a number in a list of numbers.
